sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, who sit top with 25 points from 11 games on the back of a recent win, face Cheadle Heath Nomads at home on Saturday 10 October at 15:00. The in-form leaders will then travel away to face Stockport County in a Cheshire Senior Cup first-round tie on Tuesday 13 October at 19:45 before returning to league action at home against Bilston Town on Saturday 17 October at 15:00.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, who are unbeaten in their last five league matches, travel to Telford Town on 17 October in a fixture between contrasting sides—Casuals chasing the title while Telford sit in the bottom three. Third-placed Stafford Town host Wednesfield Community on 10 October and will look to maintain their home record, while also facing Brereton Social away on 17 October. In-form Bilston Town, fourth with back-to-back wins, host Crewe on 10 October before facing a midweek trip to Sandbach and then hosting Sandbach again four days later on 17 October. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Market Drayton Town on 13 October before welcoming Barnton at home on 17 October. Barnton host Dawley Town on 10 October and visit AFC Bridgnorth on 17 October. Eccleshall face a crucial away visit to Crewe on 17 October. Struggling sides continue to fight: Crewe host Bilston on 10 October, travel to Widnes Town on 13 October (20:00 kick-off), and face Eccleshall at home on 17 October; Widnes visit Market Drayton Town on 10 October and host Crewe on 13 October; Alsager Town host Shawbury United on 10 October and travel to New Mills on 17 October; Shawbury United visit Alsager on 10 October before hosting Cheadle Heath Nomads on 17 October; Cheadle Heath Nomads host Sandbach on 10 October, visit Foley Meir on 13 October, and travel to Shawbury on 17 October; Market Drayton Town host Widnes on 10 October, host AFC Bridgnorth on 13 October, and visit Wednesfield Community on 17 October; Foley Meir host Cheadle Heath Nomads on 13 October and visit Allscott Heath on 17 October; Allscott Heath host Brereton Social on 10 October and host Foley Meir on 17 October; New Mills visit Telford Town on 10 October and host Alsager Town on 17 October; Brereton Social visit Allscott Heath on 10 October and host Stafford Town on 17 October; Telford Town host New Mills on 10 October and visit Wolverhampton Casuals on 17 October; Wednesfield Community visit Stafford Town on 10 October and host Market Drayton Town on 17 October; Widnes Town host Market Drayton Town on 10 October and visit Dawley Town on 17 October; and Dawley Town host Barnton on 10 October and visit Widnes Town on 17 October.
